simple.meaning: repose or (adverbially) peacefully ; figuratively, consolation (specifically, matrimony ); hence (concretely) an abode
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מְנוּחָה (H4496) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.

simple.summary: מְנוּחָה (mᵉnûwchâh) means repose or (adverbially) peacefully ; figuratively, consolation (specifically, matrimony ); hence (concretely) an abode First listed occurrence: 1Chr 22 9.

definitions.short: repose or (adverbially) peacefully ; figuratively, consolation (specifically, matrimony ); hence (concretely) an abode
definitions.usage: comfortable, ease, quiet, rest(-ing place), still.
definitions.full: H4496. menuchah מְנֻחָה מְנוּחָה, noun feminine resting-place, rest ; — absolute ׳מ Micah 2:10 +, מְנֻחָה Gen 49:15 (but see below), 2Sam 14:17 ; suffix מְנוּחָתִי Psa 95:11 2 t., מְנוּחָתֶ֑ךָ 132:8 2Chr 6:41 (where read as in Psalms, for anomalous לְנוּחֶ֑ךָ MT), מְנֻחָתוֺ Isa 11:10 ; Zech 9:1 ; plural מְנוּחֹת Isa 32:18 , מְנֻחוֺת Psa 23:2 ; — 1 resting-place Micah 2:10 ; Num 10:33 (JE), Deut 12:9 (+ הַנַּחֲלָה ) so Psa 95:11 ( ׳י s resting- plural), compare 132:8 2Chr 6:41 (see above), Psa 132:14 ; Isa 66:1 (|| לִי תִּבְנוּ אֲשֶׁר בַּיִת ), compare מ ׳בֵּית וגו ׳לַאֲרוֺן 1Chr 28:2 ; also Isa 11:10 ; probably also Gen 49:15 (|| הָאָרֶץ טוֺב here is apparently substantive, ⅏ reads adjective טוֺבָה ; but read perhaps מְנֻחהֹ , his resting-place , from מָנוֺחַ , Ball Hpt Holz after ᵑ6 ); שַׁאֲנַנּוֺת מְנוּחֹת Isa 32:18 (+ מִבְטַחִים מִשְׁכְּנוֺת שָׁלוֺם, נְוֵה ); of ׳י s word Zech 9:1 ; resting-place on journey, in מ ׳שַׂר Jer 51:59 (Ew Gf Gie and others); figurative for security, assurance 2Sam 14:17 (taken from resting , equilibrium, of scale according to Klo). 2 rest, quietness , plural מְנֻחוֺת מֵי Psa 23:2 ; = refreshment Isa 28:12 (|| מַרְגֵּעָה ); rest (from enemies) = peace 1Kin 8:56 (compare 5:18 ), מ ׳אִישׁ 1Chr 22:9 a man of peace (compare הֵנִיחַ v b ); = relief from sorrow Jer 45:3 ; condition of rest and security attained by marriage Ruth 1:9 (= מָנוֺחַ 3:1 ). — ׳מ Judg 20:43 is perhaps proper name, compare GFM.
